source: the gt- road ribbons of the game-look fix stage check bake g2_s1 (editor-pass/polish/g2/paving_input.py); ground = that bake's resolved heights under each point; per-vertex ground: groundGrid (fix:game-look, editor-pass/polish/g4/paving_ground.py)

chunks.note: the continent publish chunk grid on the territory window (publish_v2_client.py)

groundGrid.source: the resolved heights of the check bake g4_outline (base + sculpt layer), row-major float32 little-endian, row = +z
